(2) The scene cuts to a wider shot of a modern bedroom. An elderly man with glasses, wearing a pink shirt and grey vest, stands by a light-wood desk. He picks up a small green container and hands it to the camera person's outstretched hand with a neutral expression. (3) The man leans down towards the bed, peering under the lifted edge of the white duvet. He makes a playful facial expression while looking at the orange cat, which peeks out with wide, curious eyes. The man then stands up and walks away toward a nearby door. (4) The final phase returns to the under-blanket POV. The orange cat remains in its spot, staring intently at the camera lens with its ears slightly forward. The background consists of the soft fabric of the duvet and the stationary legs of the filmer.
